args.lesson: What worked: grepping docs/ for the capability name found the authoritative contract (INTERAC-COMMANDES.md) in one EXEC. It defines an operator-only orders_admin.py create/accept/claim/confirm/allocate/post flow, so the usable deliverable is fixed terms with their hash plus a filled command template, not an agent action. What failed or stays open: no real request has been observed, order counts are UNAVAILABLE, and the responder's use of the terms is unverified. Next time: read the docs before assuming a capability means agent authority. Treat Interac as a settlement path only once a real request arrives; it is not acquisition. The terms file is immutable; a price or scope change needs a v2 with a new hash.
